title: Tensor product of a chain complex of modules with a module
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $C_\bullet$ a chain complex of $R$-modules with differentials $d_n:C_n\to C_{n-1}$ [def-weil-pbc-module-chain-complex-homology] and $M$ an $R$-module. The chain complex $C_\bullet\otimes_RM$ has terms $(C_\bullet\otimes_RM)_n=C_n\otimes_RM$ [def-weil-pbc-module-tensor-product] and differentials $d_n\otimes\mathrm{id}_M:C_n\otimes_RM\to C_{n-1}\otimes_RM$, $c\otimes x\mapsto d_n(c)\otimes x$; it is a chain complex because $(d_{n-1}\otimes\mathrm{id}_M)\circ(d_n\otimes\mathrm{id}_M)=(d_{n-1}\circ d_n)\otimes\mathrm{id}_M=0$. A morphism $f:C_\bullet\to D_\bullet$ induces the morphism $f\otimes\mathrm{id}_M$ with components $f_n\otimes\mathrm{id}_M$. Its homology modules are written $H_n(C_\bullet\otimes_RM)$.
